reason: A DSH web UI plugin that displays and interactively manages an animated desktop pet driven by the current agent session state.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中显示一只由当前智能体会话状态驱动的可交互动画桌面宠物。
summaries.en: Displays an interactive animated desktop pet in the DeepSeek Harness web interface, driven by the current agent session state.

capabilities: Adds a floating desktop-pet overlay to the DSH web interface
Reads the current session agent status to drive pet animations and labels
Stores pet settings, position, and care values in localStorage
Supports interactive feeding, play, dragging, appearance settings, and pet-package import
